## Intention

Later in the analysis we would like to stratify based on tissue types, and patient vs control. Therefore we add variables describing this.

Input file: `02_dat_clean.tsv`\
Output file: `03_dat_aug.tsv`

## Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load files

```{r}
data_clean <- read_tsv(here("data/02_dat_clean.tsv"))
```

## Separate by tissue type

Right now the sample IDs contain information about tissue type and if it is a control or not. We would like to extract this data so we are able to stratify lafter.

```{r}
data_tissue <- data_clean |> 
  separate_wider_delim(
    Sample_ID,
    delim = " ",
    names = c(NA, "Sample", "Tissue_type"),
    too_few = "align_start"
  )
```

```{r}
data_tissue
```

## Expanding variables

Add variables describing each sample

```{r}
data_aug <- data_tissue |>
  mutate(Group = case_when(Tissue_type == "CE" ~ "Control",
                           Tissue_type == "CP" ~ "Control",
                           TRUE ~ "Patient"),
         Tissue = case_when(Tissue_type == "CE" ~ "Endometrium",
                            Tissue_type == "PE" ~ "Endometrium",
                            Tissue_type == "CP" ~ "Peritoneum",
                            Tissue_type == "PP" ~ "Peritoneum",
                            TRUE ~ "Lesion"),
         Lesion_type = case_when(Tissue_type == "PeLR" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLB" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLW" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "OMA" ~ "Ovarian endometrioma",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEIn" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEB" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "SuL" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "REV" ~ "Deep infiltrating"),
         Lesion_subtype = case_when(Tissue_type == "PeLB" ~ "Black",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLW" ~ "White",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLR" ~ "Red",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEIn" ~ "Intestinal",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEB" ~ "Bladder",
                                 Tissue_type == "REV" ~ "Rectovaginal",
                                 Tissue_type == "SuL" ~ "Sacrouterine ligament unknown"),
         Plot_group = case_when(Tissue == "Lesion" ~ Lesion_type,
                                TRUE ~ str_c(Group, " ", str_to_lower(Tissue)))) |>
  relocate(Sample, Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Lesion_subtype, Plot_group)
```

Check that every tissue code got the right labels

```{r}
data_aug |>
  count(Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Lesion_subtype, Plot_group)
```

## Save augmented data

```{r}
write_tsv(data_aug,
          here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))
```
